description: This file is a shell script used to manage prplMesh processes, including starting, stopping, restarting, checking status, rolling logs, and configuring parameters. It contains functions for process control, signal handling, log rotation, and parameter management specific to prplMesh on Linux platforms.

methods.name: send_signal_to_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Sends a specified signal (default TERM) to a prplMesh process by name.

methods.name: start_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Starts a prplMesh process in the background.

methods.name: stop_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Stops a prplMesh process by sending a signal and waiting with a timeout; escalates to KILL if necessary.

methods.name: roll_logs_function
methods.description: Rotates logs for the prplMesh processes by creating a lock, managing log files, and signaling processes to roll logs.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: odl_get_str_param
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from a list of ODL files, with a default fallback.

methods.name: odl_set_param
methods.description: Sets a parameter value in all relevant ODL files based on type.

methods.name: ensure_platform_db
methods.description: Ensures the prplMesh platform database file exists in a temporary directory.

methods.name: certification_mode_to_num
methods.description: Converts different representations of certification modes to a numeric value.

methods.name: set_management_and_certification_mode
methods.description: Configures management mode and certification mode parameters.

methods.name: start_func
methods.description: Starts all relevant prplMesh processes with the appropriate configuration.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point handling command-line arguments and orchestrating process control actions.
